```{r bootstrap, include=FALSE}
# UBAH dua nilai ini:
nomor_modul <- 1
topik_modul <- "Judul Modul Anda"

if (requireNamespace("modulstis", quietly = TRUE)) {
  th <- modulstis::theme_factory("bps")
  writeLines(th$preamble(nomor_modul, topik_modul, variant = "kunci"), "preamble.tex")
} else stop("Package 'modulstis' belum terpasang.")

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, comment = "")
knitr::knit_hooks$set(output = function(x, options) {
  paste0("\\begin{routbox}\n\\begin{verbatim}\n", x,
         "\\end{verbatim}\n\\end{routbox}\n")
})
```

```{r cover, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
th <- modulstis::theme_factory("bps")
cat(th$cover(nomor_modul, toupper(topik_modul),
  "Kunci Jawaban Latihan \\& Penugasan",
  "Pegangan dosen dan asisten praktikum.", badge = "KUNCI JAWABAN"))
```
